datasheet_identity.title: BZX84C2V4 THRU BZX84C75 SURFACE MOUNT SILICON ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: The Fig. 2 points are digitized from the labeled BZX84C33 curve; x is zener voltage and y is zener current, with the plotted y-axis logarithmic.

The BZX84C33 table row gives VZ minimum 31 V, nominal 33 V, and maximum 35 V at IZT = 2 mA; the nominal value is recorded as the breakdown-voltage target and IZT is paired as the breakdown-current target.
Reverse leakage is a maximum rating of 0.1 uA at VR = 23.1 V and TA = 25 degC, not a typical value.

The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time. It shows family-level typical capacitance curves in Fig. 5 versus nominal zener voltage, but no unambiguous device-specific capacitance-versus-reverse-bias point for BZX84C33; capacitance is therefore omitted.
The forward-voltage datum is a maximum-rated VF of 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA, not a typical value.
